phase: Block duplicate/late Tower door preview during active replay

evidence_from_video.finding: the apparent hang is a second door-preview paint replacing the already-running combat DOM; it bypasses vTowerRender and therefore was not stopped by the render guard

changes: Only one door preview is allowed per authoritative Tower route.
Any later door preview is suppressed once the battle has been seen or the battle DOM exists.
Duplicate previews that arrive before battle start are also suppressed after the first preview call.
T10H sound, cadence, image-decode and replay guards remain active.
